questions.question: When an Israelite brought a basket of firstfruits to the priest, what did Moses say he should declare?

answers.text: He had entered the land the LORD swore to give
He had gathered more than any year before
He had kept every vow his fathers made

questions.question: When presenting firstfruits, an Israelite was to say that when his people cried out in Egypt, what did the LORD do?

answers.text: He heard their voice and saw their affliction
He softened the hearts of the Egyptians
He gave them rest in the land of Goshen

questions.question: Moses said the tithe given in the third year was for the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow. True or false?
What did Moses say the LORD proclaimed about Israel, as He had promised?

answers.text: They are His people and treasured possession
They are His workers and paid laborers
They are His people for one generation
